approvers: my wife, my tax adviser and solicitor, my house bank
reason: This is my life's work, and I am not handing it to a brand-new Belize shell with no track record and no money committed. If it fails halfway I lose the business and my staff lose their jobs, and I do not know where I would take a claim.
objection: I do not know a Belize holding company. Who stands behind it, where do I take a claim if it goes wrong, and why should I believe in funding that does not exist yet?
instead: Keep running the shop and look for a buyer through nexxt-change, my Chamber, my tax adviser or a local person who wants to take it over. Or I give it to a longtime employee over time.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU-registered buyer with a named person I can meet at my shop, committed funds shown by a bank, and references from owners who sold to them, plus a written guarantee for my staff.
